notes: activations: symmetric int8, one scale per tensor, zero point 0
weights: symmetric int8, one scale per output channel, codes in [0-127..127] as two's complement
bias_int32[c]: added to the accumulator before requantisation
accumulator: int32; depthwise layers accumulate 9 products of 127 * 127, pointwise layers up to 64 * 127 * 127
requant[c]: multiply the int32 accumulator by this, round to nearest, then clamp: [-act_qmax, act_qmax] normally, [0, output_qmax] for the head
reflect_pad: reflection padding applied before a valid convolution
upsample_nearest2x: a wire, no arithmetic, no scale change
add: both operands must be on the output point grid; the second convolution is, already, and source_point is requantised by point_scales[source_point] / point_scales[point]
quantize_u8_output: the image byte is the head unsigned code, scale 1/255
depthwise_conv2d: groups == in_channels; each output channel uses only its own 3x3 kernel
